render-mode.text:
<fo:root xmlns:fo="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Format"> <fo:layout-master-set> <fo:simple-page-master master-name="receipt" page-width="80mm" page-height="297mm" margin-top="3mm" margin-bottom="3mm" margin-left="3mm" margin-right="3mm"> <fo:region-body/> </fo:simple-page-master> </fo:layout-master-set>
<fo:page-sequence master-reference="receipt"> <fo:flow flow-name="xsl-region-body">
<#-- Header Text --> <#if headerText?has_content> <fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="center" color="#666" space-after="1mm">${headerText}</fo:block> </#if>
<#-- Store Name --> <fo:block font-size="12pt" font-weight="bold" text-align="center" space-after="0.5mm">${storeName}</fo:block>
<#-- Store Address --> <#if storeAddr?has_content> <fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="center" color="#444">${storeAddr}</fo:block> </#if> <#if storePhone?has_content> <fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="center" color="#444">Ph: ${storePhone}</fo:block> </#if> <#if storeEmail?has_content> <fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="center" color="#444">${storeEmail}</fo:block> </#if> <#if taxReg?has_content> <fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="center" color="#444">Tax Reg: ${taxReg}</fo:block> </#if>
<#-- Separator --> <fo:block space-before="1.5mm" space-after="1.5mm" border-bottom="0.5pt dashed #000"/>
<#-- Invoice Header --> <fo:block font-size="9pt" font-weight="bold" text-align="center" space-after="1mm">TAX INVOICE</fo:block>
<fo:table table-layout="fixed" width="100%"> <fo:table-column column-width="25mm"/><fo:table-column column-width="proportional-column-width(1)"/> <fo:table-body> <fo:table-row><fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" color="#666">Invoice No:</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" font-weight="bold">${billNo}</fo:block></fo:table-cell></fo:table-row> <fo:table-row><fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" color="#666">Date:</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt">${billDate}</fo:block></fo:table-cell></fo:table-row> <#if operatorName?has_content> <fo:table-row><fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" color="#666">Cashier:</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt">${operatorName}</fo:block></fo:table-cell></fo:table-row> </#if> <fo:table-row><fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" color="#666">Customer:</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt">${customerName}</fo:block></fo:table-cell></fo:table-row> <#if customerPhone?has_content> <fo:table-row><fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" color="#666">Mobile:</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt">${customerPhone}</fo:block></fo:table-cell></fo:table-row> </#if> </fo:table-body> </fo:table>
<#-- Separator --> <fo:block space-before="1.5mm" space-after="1mm" border-bottom="0.5pt solid #000"/>
<#-- Items Table Header --> <fo:table table-layout="fixed" width="100%"> <fo:table-column column-width="proportional-column-width(3)"/> <fo:table-column column-width="10mm"/> <fo:table-column column-width="14mm"/> <fo:table-column column-width="16mm"/> <fo:table-header> <fo:table-row background-color="#f0f0f0"> <fo:table-cell padding="1pt"><fo:block font-size="7pt" font-weight="bold">Item</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell padding="1pt"><fo:block font-size="7pt" font-weight="bold" text-align="center">Qty</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell padding="1pt"><fo:block font-size="7pt" font-weight="bold" text-align="right">Rate</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell padding="1pt"><fo:block font-size="7pt" font-weight="bold" text-align="right">Total</fo:block></fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> </fo:table-header> <fo:table-body> <#list items as item> <fo:table-row> <fo:table-cell padding="1pt"><fo:block font-size="7pt">${(item.productName!item.productId!'')?xml}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell padding="1pt"><fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="center">${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(item.quantity!0, '#,##0.##'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell padding="1pt"><fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="right">${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(item.unitPrice!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell padding="1pt"><fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="right">${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(item.lineTotal!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> <#if ((item.discountAmount!0)) gt 0> <fo:table-row> <fo:table-cell number-columns-spanned="4" padding="0pt"> <fo:block font-size="6pt" color="#666" margin-left="3mm">Disc: -${cs}${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(item.discountAmount!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block> </fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> </#if> </#list> </fo:table-body> </fo:table>
<#-- Separator --> <fo:block space-before="1mm" space-after="1mm" border-bottom="0.5pt dashed #000"/>
<#-- Summary --> <fo:table table-layout="fixed" width="100%"> <fo:table-column column-width="proportional-column-width(1)"/><fo:table-column column-width="20mm"/> <fo:table-body> <fo:table-row> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt">Total Qty: ${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(totalQty, '#,##0.##'))} | Items: ${items.size()}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block/></fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> </fo:table-body> </fo:table>
<fo:table table-layout="fixed" width="100%" space-before="1mm"> <fo:table-column column-width="proportional-column-width(1)"/><fo:table-column column-width="24mm"/> <fo:table-body> <fo:table-row> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt">Taxable (after discount)</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="right">${cs}${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(txn.subtotal!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> <#if ((txn.discountTotal!0)) gt 0> <fo:table-row> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt">Discount included</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="right">${cs}${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(txn.discountTotal!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> </#if> <#if ((txn.totalTaxAmount!0)) gt 0> <fo:table-row> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt">Tax</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="right">${cs}${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(txn.totalTaxAmount!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> </#if> <#if ((txn.roundOff!0)) != 0> <fo:table-row> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="6pt" color="#666">Round Off</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="6pt" text-align="right" color="#666">${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(txn.roundOff!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> </#if> </fo:table-body> </fo:table>
<#-- Grand Total --> <fo:block space-before="1mm" space-after="0.5mm" border-bottom="1pt solid #000"/> <fo:table table-layout="fixed" width="100%"> <fo:table-column column-width="proportional-column-width(1)"/><fo:table-column column-width="24mm"/> <fo:table-body> <fo:table-row> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="10pt" font-weight="bold">TOTAL</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="10pt" font-weight="bold" text-align="right">${cs}${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(txn.payableAmount!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> </fo:table-body> </fo:table> <fo:block space-before="0.5mm" space-after="1mm" border-bottom="1pt solid #000"/>
<#-- Payment Breakdown --> <fo:table table-layout="fixed" width="100%"> <fo:table-column column-width="proportional-column-width(1)"/><fo:table-column column-width="24mm"/> <fo:table-body> <#list payments as pmt> <fo:table-row> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt">${pmt.paymentMethod!''}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="right">${cs}${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(pmt.amount!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> </#list> <#if ((txn.changeAmount!0)) gt 0> <fo:table-row> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" font-weight="bold">Change</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="right" font-weight="bold">${cs}${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(txn.changeAmount!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> </#if> </fo:table-body> </fo:table>
<#-- Credit / Pay Later marker + amount due (ZE-POS-005) --> <#if isCreditBill> <fo:block space-before="1mm" space-after="0.5mm" border-bottom="0.5pt dashed #000"/> <fo:block font-size="9pt" font-weight="bold" text-align="center" border="0.5pt solid #000" padding="1mm" space-after="1mm">** CREDIT / PAY LATER (UNPAID) **</fo:block> <fo:table table-layout="fixed" width="100%"> <fo:table-column column-width="proportional-column-width(1)"/><fo:table-column column-width="24mm"/> <fo:table-body> <fo:table-row> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="9pt" font-weight="bold">Amount Due</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="9pt" font-weight="bold" text-align="right">${cs}${outstandingAmt}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> </fo:table-body> </fo:table> </#if>
<#-- Savings --> <#if (totalSaving gt 0)> <fo:block space-before="1.5mm" space-after="1mm" border-bottom="0.5pt dashed #000"/> <fo:block font-size="8pt" font-weight="bold" text-align="center">You Saved: ${cs}${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(totalSaving, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block> </#if>
<#-- Terms --> <#if termsText?has_content> <fo:block space-before="1.5mm" space-after="1mm" border-bottom="0.5pt dashed #000"/> <fo:block font-size="6pt" text-align="center" color="#666" linefeed-treatment="preserve">${termsText}</fo:block> </#if>
<#-- Footer --> <#if footerText?has_content> <fo:block space-before="1mm" border-bottom="0.5pt dashed #000"/> <fo:block font-size="6pt" text-align="center" color="#666" space-before="1mm" linefeed-treatment="preserve">${footerText}</fo:block> </#if>
<fo:block font-size="9pt" font-weight="bold" text-align="center" space-before="2mm">Thank You !!</fo:block>
</fo:flow> </fo:page-sequence> </fo:root>
